passage: The science behind Supartz. Sodium hyaluronate, the fluid used in Supartz injections, is present naturally in healthy joints as a shock absorber and lubricant. When your joints don’t produce enough hyaluronate, it can cause stiffness and pain. Supartz injections put the fluid back into your knee joint, so the parts of the joint should slide past each other more easily.
